title: Beca
bio: Beca is a 19-year-old hobby artist. She started making digital art more seriously 2 years ago, before that, she only drew on paper. Though she believes she still needs to learn a lot, she always tries her best when drawing. Beca will draw anything from regular dogs to mythical dragon creatures seeing as she’s a maniac dragon lover who also happens to love playing video games, editing videos, etc. But mostly, she spends her time drawing digitally.
